title: The Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC):
summary: The Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Launched on 19 February 2015 at Suratgarh, Rajasthan, aims to improve soil health and agricultural
productivity. The scheme issues soil health cards to farmers every two years, advising them on
appropriate fertilizer use based on soil nutrient status. It tests soil on 12 parameters, including NPK
o Over 24 crore soil health cards issued.
o Helps address soil fertility issues.
In 2023, it was merged with Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) as Soil Health and Fertility
for better coordination. The scheme helps reduce fertilizer misuse, promotes sustainable agriculture,
